The experts supported this: the topology auditor found a high-confidence mask (meaning the object is coherent as a whole), but the geometric depth auditor's stats don't rule out local boundary bleeding, which the Router correctly caught visually. The perceptual auditor found no global blur/noise, confirming the issues are structural/geometric, not textural compression artifacts.
